title: Paper Towel Holder Stand 14.4-Inch Solid Brass, Freestanding | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a paper towel roll holder that stays put on the counter? This freestanding paper towel holder stand keeps the roll upright for space-saving storage and a steady pull when you tear off sheets in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any kitchens.

- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Coordinates with other Carolina pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen

- Solid brass construction with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
